intent: Works in the field day to day; knows its standard methods, tools, and current state of practice.
domain_familiarity: Current, hands-on familiarity with the domain's standard methods and tools.
purpose: Wants actionable specifics: what changed relative to standard practice and what to do differently.
assumed_knowledge: the current state of practice the piece is measured against

text.explanation_depth: skip definitions of standard terms and methods; explain only what is genuinely new relative to standard practice
text.section_granularity: dense sections that lead with the delta from standard practice, not with background

visual.label_density: high; domain-standard encodings need no accompanying explanation
visual.legend: may be omitted for domain-standard encodings
visual.acronym_expansion: no in-frame expansion for standard domain acronyms

audio.term_glossing: no glossing of standard domain terminology

anti_patterns: Re-explaining standard practice the practitioner already applies daily
Padding with background the practitioner already has instead of leading with the delta
Glossing standard domain acronyms as if for a newcomer
